subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should maintainers land a narrow WhatsApp final-error delivery fix for this concrete issue now, or fold all remaining work into the broader durable final fallback contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: Current main has a partial run-lifecycle fix, but the WhatsApp adapter still contains the exact final-error suppression paths; choosing the narrow immediate patch versus the broader channel-contract path is a maintainer ownership/product call.

options.title: Land Narrow WhatsApp Fix
options.body: Revive or reimplement the PR #84578 shape so final `isError` fallback text is deliverable in WhatsApp while leaving cross-channel semantics to the broader issue.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Contract
options.body: Keep this issue linked as concrete evidence and implement the fix only as part of the durable final fallback delivery contract work.

options.title: Require Live Release Proof First
options.body: Hold closure until a release containing PR #102160 plus any delivery fix shows a long WhatsApp model call producing a visible fallback or explicit delivery failure.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow WhatsApp Fix
recommendation.body: Revive or reimplement the PR #84578 shape so final `isError` fallback text is deliverable in WhatsApp while leaving cross-channel semantics to the broader issue.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to this issue and authored the broader fallback delivery contract issue that frames the remaining product boundary.
